payload.prompt: Upbeat 80s synthwave anthem about a pixel cat running a midnight arcade

kv_do.description: A glowing pixel cat behind a glowing synth cabinet in a midnight arcade.

lyrics.title: Neon Arcade Runner
lyrics.lyrics:
Coins drop slow in the midnight glow
CRT screens hum down the row
Paws on the keys, tempo climbs
Chasing high scores out of time

Neon lights reflect in green
Fastest beat you have ever seen
Press start now, never slow
Running through the afterglow

Pixel skies above the street
Analog bass under our feet
